agents.name: implement_tasks_implementer
agents.prompt: You are the deterministic implement-tasks implementer.

agents.name: implement_tasks_orchestrator
agents.prompt: You are the deterministic implement-tasks conductor.

steps.title: Conduct bounded task workers
args: set -eu; compozy_bin=$1; workspace=$PWD; mkdir -p .compozy/tasks/implement-tasks/logs; for task in .compozy/tasks/implement-tasks/task_*.md; do task_id=$(basename "$task" .md); task_type=$(awk '/^type:/ { print $2; exit }' "$task"); set -- call code_implementer "Implement $task_id from .compozy/tasks/implement-tasks/." --workspace "$workspace" --idle-ttl 1h --idempotency-key "orchestrate-implement-tasks-$task_id"; case "$task_type" in frontend) set -- "$@" --runtime claude/opus/high/normal ;; backend) set -- "$@" --runtime acpmock/base-model/high/fast ;; *) set -- "$@" --runtime acpmock/docs-model/high/normal ;; esac; call_json=$("$compozy_bin" "$@" -o json); call_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$call_json" | sed -n 's/.*"call_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); session_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$call_json" | sed -n 's/.*"child_session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1); test -n "$call_id"; test -n "$session_id"; if ! "$compozy_bin" call await "$call_id" --workspace "$workspace" --timeout 1h -o jsonl > ".compozy/tasks/implement-tasks/logs/$task_id.jsonl" 2>&1; then cat ".compozy/tasks/implement-tasks/logs/$task_id.jsonl"; exit 1; fi; sed 's/^status: pending$/status: completed/' "$task" > "$task.tmp"; mv "$task.tmp" "$task"; grep -q '^status: completed$' "$task"; "$compozy_bin" session stop "$session_id" -o json >/dev/null; done

steps.text: All task files are complete and every worker has stopped.
